description: This source file defines the 'BatchContainerBatch' class, a sealed class implementing the 'IBatchContainerBatch' interface. It represents a batch of batch containers used in Orleans streaming, encapsulating a list of batch containers and exposing methods to retrieve events and import request context. The class contains properties for the stream identifier, sequence token, and batch containers, and includes a constructor that initializes these properties based on the provided batch containers.

classes.name: BatchContainerBatch
classes.description: A class representing a batch of batch containers in Orleans streaming, providing access to stream ID, sequence token, contained batch objects, and methods to retrieve events and import request context.

methods.name: BatchContainerBatch
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the batch container batch with a list of batch containers, extracting stream ID and sequence token from the first container.

methods.name: GetEvents
methods.description: Returns an enumerable of tuples containing events of type T and their stream sequence tokens, aggregating events from all batch containers.

methods.name: ImportRequestContext
methods.description: Imports the request context from the first batch container in the batch.
